integrity: The exact formula is proved by a four-family alternating-path/cycle decomposition and the limit by factorial ratios plus a cycle-negligibility estimate. The bundled portable verifier exhaustively checks 34 finite parameter strata; these do not certify the infinite theorem.
scientific_limitations: Complete graphs in standard edge-coordinate Euclidean metric only; high-rank limit fixes the number of uncovered vertices. Older general path/cycle counting is credited. Historical priority against unindexed equivalents is provisional. Finite tests are supporting checks, not infinite proofs. No independent mathematical validation has been performed.
title: Poisson-scale Euclidean edge lengths in complete-graph matching polytopes
